Class ByteBodyElements<T>

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.PulledBodyElements<T>
io.micronaut.http.body.stream.ByteBodyElements<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The type of an element
All Implemented Interfaces:
BodyElements<T>, AutoCloseable, Subscriber<ReadBuffer>
@Internal public final class ByteBodyElements<T> extends PulledBodyElements<T> implements Subscriber<ReadBuffer>
The elements of a body, read through a PieceReader as they are asked for, without Reactor: a read polls the next element of the pieces read so far, and requests the next piece of the body when they complete no other element. An element is decoded when it is polled, so nothing is decoded ahead of the caller. An element that the pieces read so far complete is handed out at once (PulledBodyElements.poll(), a completed PulledBodyElements.next()).

To hide the latency of the connection, one piece is requested ahead once a requested piece answered a read: the bytes of at most one piece are received before they are asked for.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Denis Stepanov

    • takeUnreadAvailableBody

      public @Nullable CloseableByteBody takeUnreadAvailableBody()
      Transfer an untouched, already-buffered raw body without another buffer or subscription. Streaming bodies cannot use this shortcut: reusing their shared buffer would change the buffering limits of the adapted body. On success these elements are closed and the caller owns the returned body.
      Returns:
      The body, or null when the shortcut is not applicable

    • toPublisher

      public Publisher<T> toPublisher()
      The elements as a publisher for the reactive API: the elements are pushed as the pieces of the body are read, by a lock-free publisher without a future per element. These elements can no longer be pulled.
      Returns:

    • demand

      protected void demand()
      Description copied from class: PulledBodyElements
      Ask the source for more elements. Called by a read that found nothing available, outside the lock. The source answers with PulledBodyElements.push(T), PulledBodyElements.end() or PulledBodyElements.fail(Throwable); a source that produced nothing for the read must ask itself again while PulledBodyElements.isWaiting().
      Specified by:
      demand in class PulledBodyElements<T>

    • pollSource

      protected @Nullable T pollSource()
      Description copied from class: PulledBodyElements
      Take an element that the source can produce at once, without waiting, e.g. the next element of a piece of the body it already received. Called under the lock of these elements, only while no read waits for the source. A failure is reported with PulledBodyElements.fail(Throwable).
      Overrides:
      pollSource in class PulledBodyElements<T>
      Returns:
      The element, or null
